description: Implementation of the 'Post-Cyclone Ditwah Reconstruction and Livelihood Support Project'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-06-15 to conduct negotiations with the Asian Development Bank to obtain a loan facility to implement the 'Post-Cyclone Ditwah Reconstruction and Livelihood Support Project'. Accordingly, based on the negotiations held, US$ 100 million is to be obtained from the Concessional Ordinary Capital Resources and US$ 100 million from the Regular Ordinary Capital Resources of the Asian Development Bank, under the relevant loan facility. The loan facility is planned to be used for 03 key components, the rehabilitation and reconstruction of road infrastructure damaged due to the cyclone, restoration of damaged irrigation systems and restoration of livelihoods and housing of affected families. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to enter into the relevant financial agreements to obtain the said financial facility from the Asian Development Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.
